predecessors.name: First Turkic Khaganate
predecessors.text: the western half of the First Turkic Khaganate: Istami 'ruled the western part of the territory of the Göktürks', which became the Western Turkic Khaganate (Istami page)

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: Dzungaria, the Chu and Ili valleys and (from 648) the Tarim oases

successors.name: Tokhara Yabghus
successors.text: Tokharistan, ruled from Kunduz by the Yabghus

ledger.x: 587: the western half of the Goktürks stands as its own khaganate under Tardu and Niri Qaghan.
587: Turfan and Hami as a Turkic client oasis.

588: the Turks cross the Oxus. under Bagha Qaghan the Turks briefly took Balkh, Talaqan, Badghis and Herat (Tokhara Yabghus page, 588-589); WTK page: 'In 588-589 the Turks were defeated by Persians near Herat'.
589: Bahram Chobin drives the Turks back over the Oxus; the Oxus line (WTK page: 'In 571 a border was drawn along the Oxus') holds again and the land south of it stays Sasanian.

599: Tardu 'declared himself to be khagan of the united khaganate', claiming the eastern half after Tulan Qaghan's death; 'his new status was not recognised widely' and the campaign he launched against China failed.
602: the Tarim oasis states as clients.
ledger.cp: Tarim oasis states (Kucha, Karasahr, Kashgar, Khotan)

ledger.x: 603: Tardu is gone and the two khaganates are separate for good.
625: Tong Yabghu takes Tokharistan.

627: Turks and Khazars take Derbent and sack Aghvania. in early 627 Göktürk and Khazar forces took Derbent and sacked Aghvania, then besieged Tbilisi; Tong Yabghu planned to incorporate Aghvania into his khaganate rather than only plunder it.
627: the Khazars fight under Bori Shad, 'the westernmost vassal tribes' (Tong Yabghu page); the Khazar forces besiege Tbilisi (Third Perso-Turkic War page).
627: the Pontic steppe under Great Bulgaria's clients.
629: Armenia.
630: Tong Yabghu is murdered by his uncle Kulug Sibir (page: 'c.
630: the Onogur Bulgars on the Pontic steppe break away (see the Khazar entry); Old Great Bulgaria stands from 633 in Cliopatria and Kubrat's union is dated 'between 630 and 635' on its page.
630: the Caucasus is given back.
630: Dagestan (Derbent) passes to the Khazars, whose country Cliopatria draws on the North Caucasus and the Terek from 630.
640: Gaochang falls.
647: 114 cells (about 28,800 km2, 96 of them in the Kazakh Steppe) pass from Cliopatria's Western Göktürks 646 shape to its Khazaria 647 shape; the Khazars page has the khaganate dominating c.
648: the northern Tarim oases pass to the Tang.
ledger.cp: Tarim oasis states (Kucha, Karasahr, Kashgar, Khotan)

ledger.x: 648: the Tarim goes to the Tang (the clients' land, hatched out of the khaganate's tint); matching the Tang dossier's 648 gain from this state.
657: the steppe goes to the Tang.
657: Tokharistan is left to its Yabghus under Tang suzerainty.

657: the Sogdian cities and the Ferghana and Chach oases, drawn by Cliopatria as Western Goktürk land to 660, are left to their princes (Helu fled to Chach, whose ruler Yixian Tarkhan handed him over, Ashina Helu page).
657: the Kazakh steppe, the Altai and Khwarezm, left to their tribes.
657: the Western Turkic Khaganate falls.

wars.name: Turkic invasion of Bactria and Khorasan
wars.outcome: The Turks briefly took Balkh, Talaqan, Badghis and Herat and were defeated near Herat by Bahram Chobin; the Oxus stays the frontier.

wars.name: Tardu's bid for the united khaganate
wars.outcome: Tardu declared himself khagan of the united khaganate in 599 and was not widely recognised; his campaign against China failed and he vanished in 603 or 604 after a rebellion, leaving the two khaganates permanently divided.

wars.name: Third Perso-Turkic War
wars.outcome: Göktürk-Byzantine victory (infobox): Derbent and Aghvania sacked, Tbilisi taken after a siege, Chorpan Tarkhan's April 630 ambush in Armenia; Tong Yabghu's murder about 630 ends the Turkic hold on the Caucasus.

wars.name: Tang campaigns against the Western Turks
wars.outcome: Tang victory: Gaochang annexed in 640, Karasahr in 644/648, Kucha surrendered 19 January 649, Ashina Helu beaten on the Irtysh in 657 and the khaganate annexed.

certainty.note: Steppe, desert and mountain frontiers throughout; the Oxus line of 571 (WTK page: 'a border was drawn along the Oxus') and the Derbent frontier of 627-630 are the only fixed lines and neither is surveyed.
